name: hud_sensor_tracker_load_race_checkpoint_meta
description: HudSensorTracker::LoadRaceCheckpointMeta loads race.zrd, detects cp_count, sets race timer/checkpoint count, frees the loaded tree, and returns whether race checkpoint mode is active. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4193c0 validates the CString path format, race.zrd load, cp_count lookup, 20-second runtime timer store, checkpoint count load from the cp_count payload, loaded-tree free, CString cleanup, and return flag.
The native smoke verifies the missing-race metadata path leaves existing timer/count fields unchanged and the archive-backed cp_count path returns active race mode with timer/count side effects.
